$comment: [X4.15] Qdrant MCP attach spec. Tier-2 VERIFIED-PUBLISHER (publisher `qdrant` — official Qdrant MCP server from github.com/qdrant/mcp-server-qdrant; candidate set, trust elevated in X4.15). Shape === mcp-specs/_template.json (X2.1). Semantic-memory layer over the Qdrant vector search engine. CC0-1.0.
title: Qdrant Vector Memory
description: Store and retrieve semantic memories in the Qdrant vector search engine via the official Qdrant MCP server.

env_vars.name: QDRANT_URL
env_vars.description: URL of the Qdrant server (e.g. https://xyz.cloud.qdrant.io:6333 for Qdrant Cloud, or http://localhost:6333 for a local instance). An embedded QDRANT_LOCAL_PATH may be used instead.

env_vars.name: QDRANT_API_KEY
env_vars.description: API key for the Qdrant server. Required for Qdrant Cloud; optional for a local/unauthenticated instance. Pass via env, never inline in args (doctrine #6).

env_vars.name: COLLECTION_NAME
env_vars.description: Name of the default collection to read/write. Created automatically if it does not exist.

env_vars.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
env_vars.description: FastEmbed model used to encode memories (default sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2). Only FastEmbed models are supported.

env_vars.name: QDRANT_READ_ONLY
env_vars.description: When set to true, disables the qdrant-store write tool — a read-only retrieval posture.

auth.recipe: create a Qdrant Cloud cluster (cloud.qdrant.io) and set QDRANT_URL + QDRANT_API_KEY; or run a local Qdrant and point QDRANT_URL at http://localhost:6333.

sample_tools.name: qdrant-store
sample_tools.summary: Store information (with optional metadata) as a memory in a Qdrant collection.

sample_tools.name: qdrant-find
sample_tools.summary: Retrieve relevant memories from a Qdrant collection via semantic search.

known_limitations: First run downloads the FastEmbed embedding model (default sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2) into the local cache, adding startup latency and disk usage; only FastEmbed models are supported.
Runs via `uvx mcp-server-qdrant`, so the host needs uv / Python available on PATH; the package is fetched and installed on first launch.
Targeting Qdrant Cloud requires QDRANT_URL plus a QDRANT_API_KEY credential; a local instance or embedded QDRANT_LOCAL_PATH can run unauthenticated, and QDRANT_READ_ONLY=true disables the write tool.
Destructive-action audit (X2.18): no destructive tools — qdrant-store appends a memory and qdrant-find reads; neither drops collections or removes points.

client_install.claude_desktop: Add to claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers as `qdrant`: { command: uvx, args: [mcp-server-qdrant], env: { QDRANT_URL, QDRANT_API_KEY, COLLECTION_NAME } }.
client_install.cursor: Run `uvx mcp-server-qdrant --transport sse` and point Cursor/Windsurf at the SSE endpoint; set QDRANT_URL + COLLECTION_NAME in the env.
client_install.vscode: Add to .vscode/mcp.json servers as `qdrant` with promptString inputs for QDRANT_URL, QDRANT_API_KEY, and COLLECTION_NAME.
